methodology.summary: Opponent-adjusted, regularized football ratings with expanding weekly validation and historical NFL EPA/success/sack features.

variables.name: Opponent-adjusted team strength
variables.description: Regularized ratings separate a team's scoring margin from opponent strength. Recent games receive gradually greater weight; blowout margins are capped during fitting.

variables.name: Offensive and defensive scoring
variables.description: Separate offense and defense ratings project combined scoring against this opponent, with shrinkage toward league average.

variables.name: Home field and neutral sites
variables.description: A weak home-field prior is adjusted by the historical margin fit. Neutral-site games receive no home advantage.

variables.name: Net EPA per play and passing EPA
variables.description: NFL play-by-play measures the value of each play. Strictly earlier-week rolling offensive and defensive EPA and passing EPA enter the regularized fit. No EPA is inferred from ordinary yardage.

variables.name: Success and explosive-play rates
variables.description: Rolling offensive and defensive consistency and big-play rates enter the NFL fit when historical play-by-play coverage is sufficient.

variables.name: Pass protection and pass rush
variables.description: Observed sack rates enter the NFL model as a limited pressure proxy. True pressure rate, offensive-line availability, and pass-block win rate are not measured here.

variables.name: QB availability and injuries
variables.description: Fresh injury reports are checked against the latest game's primary passer when known; uncertainty for that passer blocks a best-bet designation. A recent passer is not a confirmed starter. Missing reports do not mean healthy, and no unsupported injury point value is invented.

variables.name: Yards per play, pace, turnovers, third downs
variables.description: Measured season rates help inspect each matchup. They are not added to fitted predictions without matching historical as-of inputs, and volatile turnover/red-zone outcomes are not over-weighted.

variables.name: Weather, rest, travel and lineup changes
variables.description: Rest and venue context are shown where available. Forecast wind/rain, travel effects and confirmed starters are not assigned numerical adjustments in this version.

variables.name: Bookmaker line, price and freshness
variables.description: Evaluate the actual line and price at one named bookmaker, including push outcomes. Market prices never train the team model; a pick needs positive estimated value after a conservative three-point stress test.

selection_rules: At least 6 prior games per team and 30 chronological holdout games.
At least 4 percentage points of estimated edge and $7 EV per $100, plus positive EV after a three-point adverse model shift.
Bookmaker quote no older than 26 hours, with a valid timestamp and no failed-refresh flag. Started games are excluded.
The corresponding score model must beat a simple league-average/home-field baseline on chronological holdouts.
At most one qualifying wager per game. No pick is forced when the data or estimated edge is weak.
limitations: Probability and EV estimates are provisional, not demonstrated profitable betting returns.
Score errors use a discretized normal approximation. Pushes are included, but football's exact key-number frequencies and correlated scoring are not fully calibrated.
QB changes, missing injury reports and weather can overwhelm a statistical edge. CFB injury coverage is especially incomplete.
Season-to-date estimates can be unstable after coaching/roster changes. Compare the listed price with the price actually offered before considering a wager.

validation.label: Chronological score validation; betting returns untested
validation.notes: Each held-out week is predicted using earlier weeks only. Error is measured in points. Available NFL closing spreads/totals provide a forecast-error benchmark, never a training input. Historical bet prices are unavailable, so these errors do not establish betting profitability or probability calibration.

weekly.no_bet_reason: No upcoming game currently clears the model's data, price, and uncertainty checks. Watchlist entries are not recommendations.

methodology.summary: Opponent-adjusted, regularized football ratings with expanding weekly validation. Advanced per-play features are unavailable for this slate; this is a scoring-based baseline.

variables.name: Opponent-adjusted team strength
variables.description: Regularized ratings separate a team's scoring margin from opponent strength. Recent games receive gradually greater weight; blowout margins are capped during fitting.

variables.name: Offensive and defensive scoring
variables.description: Separate offense and defense ratings project combined scoring against this opponent, with shrinkage toward league average.

variables.name: Home field and neutral sites
variables.description: A weak home-field prior is adjusted by the historical margin fit. Neutral-site games receive no home advantage.

variables.name: Net EPA per play and passing EPA
variables.description: NFL play-by-play measures the value of each play. Strictly earlier-week rolling offensive and defensive EPA and passing EPA enter the regularized fit. No EPA is inferred from ordinary yardage.

variables.name: Success and explosive-play rates
variables.description: Rolling offensive and defensive consistency and big-play rates enter the NFL fit when historical play-by-play coverage is sufficient.

variables.name: Pass protection and pass rush
variables.description: Observed sack rates enter the NFL model as a limited pressure proxy. True pressure rate, offensive-line availability, and pass-block win rate are not measured here.

variables.name: QB availability and injuries
variables.description: Fresh injury reports are checked against the latest game's primary passer when known; uncertainty for that passer blocks a best-bet designation. A recent passer is not a confirmed starter. Missing reports do not mean healthy, and no unsupported injury point value is invented.

variables.name: Yards per play, pace, turnovers, third downs
variables.description: Measured season rates help inspect each matchup. They are not added to fitted predictions without matching historical as-of inputs, and volatile turnover/red-zone outcomes are not over-weighted.

variables.name: Weather, rest, travel and lineup changes
variables.description: Rest and venue context are shown where available. Forecast wind/rain, travel effects and confirmed starters are not assigned numerical adjustments in this version.

variables.name: Bookmaker line, price and freshness
variables.description: Evaluate the actual line and price at one named bookmaker, including push outcomes. Market prices never train the team model; a pick needs positive estimated value after a conservative three-point stress test.

selection_rules: At least 6 prior games per team and 80 chronological holdout games.
At least 6 percentage points of estimated edge and $10 EV per $100, plus positive EV after a three-point adverse model shift.
Bookmaker quote no older than 26 hours, with a valid timestamp and no failed-refresh flag. Started games are excluded.
The corresponding score model must beat a simple league-average/home-field baseline on chronological holdouts.
At most one qualifying wager per game. No pick is forced when the data or estimated edge is weak.
limitations: Probability and EV estimates are provisional, not demonstrated profitable betting returns.
Score errors use a discretized normal approximation. Pushes are included, but football's exact key-number frequencies and correlated scoring are not fully calibrated.
QB changes, missing injury reports and weather can overwhelm a statistical edge. CFB injury coverage is especially incomplete.
Season-to-date estimates can be unstable after coaching/roster changes. Compare the listed price with the price actually offered before considering a wager.

validation.label: Chronological score validation; betting returns untested
validation.notes: Each held-out week is predicted using earlier weeks only. Error is measured in points. Available NFL closing spreads/totals provide a forecast-error benchmark, never a training input. Historical bet prices are unavailable, so these errors do not establish betting profitability or probability calibration.

Summary counts the first saved selection per game and market, at $100 per priced selection; later opposing selections and unpriced goal predictions are excluded. Pushes return the stake; voids are excluded. Missing or postponed results stay pending. No historical closing-line value is claimed.
